ops:
-action removes the frontmatter of the template (`description`, `argument-hint`), and replaces these variables with the arguments after `/<name>`:

| Variable | Value |
|----------|-------|
| `$1` … `$9` | One argument. Empty when there is no such argument |
| `$ARGUMENTS`, `$@` | All arguments, separated by spaces |
| `${@:N}` | The arguments from argument N |
| `${@:N:L}` | L
